text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Ah.
Trainer, it's over there.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Mother!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Messiah! ...And Trainer-san too.
Thank you for coming."

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
Even though it's such a busy time right before the Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: No, taking a break is important too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Shuka Sho just around the corner,
I was invited by Air Messiah's mother to visit the Umamusume's
autumn festival—the Shundai Festival.

text_block_list.name: Ritual Staff Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Make way for the float, coming throuuugh!!
Everyone, chant along with me!!
All together now—'Heave... HO'!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ready—set!!
Ready—set!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Chanting in unison, the Umamusume clad in happi coats pulled an enormous, magnificent float modeled after the Three Goddesses. It was a truly powerful sight...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Last year I visited with Heart-san and the others...
The Shundai Festival is always so lively every year, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Back in my school days, when people talked about
'wishing for the further prosperity and peace of Umamusume,'
it never really clicked with me, though.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, even this lively hustle and bustle...
somehow fills me with deep emotion."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother...?

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Now then, first up has to be grilled carrots, right?! Trainer-san, if anything catches your eye, please let me know too!"

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: You can see all kinds of performances unique to this festival. Look, for instance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Jingle――...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Air Messiah and I both held our breath.
Before our eyes, Umamusume clad in divine Japanese
attire were dancing with breathtaking grace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dancers dedicate their sacred dance to the Three Goddesses,
said to be the progenitors of all Umamusume, praying for their blessing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I watched, captivated and forgetting to breathe, the majestic and beautiful dance continued for some time...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That was... a truly wonderful dance.
Its pure and serene aura has cleansed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as I nod, I take a quick look around.
...Just as I thought, they aren't here.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true, isn't it...
While we were completely absorbed in the danceâ

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mother...
Where could she have gone?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list: Is that from your mom, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, there's a message...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
Somewhere you want me to come—?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Umm... what Mother was talking about
is likely around here, but—

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Messiah, Trainer!
...Sorry for dropping in out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Moth—... er?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her mother suddenly pop out from the bushes, Air Messiah is struck speechless. Then, she quietly murmurs—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......Beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Fufu, I was a bit worried
whether it would even fit me, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ask, unable to take my eyes off her as well.
Though a bit old-fashioned in style, that gorgeous, dazzling figure, just like the one seen moments ago—

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a long time ago, but...
I, too, was once chosen to perform the 'Dedication Dance.'

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Messiah. I've been thinking about how best to send you off to the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...! Mother—

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I thought about so many things to say, too.
...But you're such a good girl, I was worried
I might end up making you shoulder everything.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"So, not with words... but just with my feelings.
Please let me deliver them with all the effort I can muster."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for her daughter, and for those heartfelt feelings,
she danced with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bell held high chimed with a crisp ring.
Sleeves fluttering in the night breeze swayed the bonfire's flames.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Infused within that beautiful dance is a prayer.
A prayer purely, truly, and earnestly innocent.
And poignantly profound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘May you stay safe and sound.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “May your wishes come true”——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so arrived the day of the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accompanying me in my relaxation routine today as well,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: No. Your condition... looks all set.
No. Your condition... looks fully in order.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am nervous. I feel the pressure as well.
...However, even so, I am prepared.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Because I can feel a solid footing beneath me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You're just assuming they're there, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that is what it sounded like to you, then so be it.
...Hmm, is it not time to enter the paddock yet?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Like I'd know. If that's how it looks to you, then that's what it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean... hah.
Look at that, they're worried about 'em.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is it? Did you come here because you were worried as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: As if that'd happen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I haven't.
...Not worried in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: She's just gonna—anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Alright!!
I'm ready when you are!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The final tiara at the Shuka Sho...
I will definitely, absolutely take it!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here they come, here they come!
Rhein Kraft and Air Messiah...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She was incredible in the NHK Mile Cup too!
I wonder which one will take it today—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, it's not just "which of the two"!
Daring Heart is here too, you know!
I'm sure she'll be hitting her stride any time now...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Oh.
Well, well, well――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Messiah.
You're looking... awesome today!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: My... It is an honor, Mr. Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When we spoke at the start of the summer camp,
you looked a little pale, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even your cheeks are very cute right now.
...That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to this so much, Messiah.
The ultimate showdown against you at your absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Though I cannot say "Me too"
from the bottom of my heart, however.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You... all of you, are truly strong.
You stand out above the rest. ...However.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Come at me, please.
I shall meet you head-on.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With everything handed down and built up since my mother's era!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let us make it blossom beautifully this autumn.
